guide.minecities.title: Town Guide
guide.minecities.cover:
Living towns: build your own way, the mod recognises your houses and citizens come to live in them.

The village grows into a town, a city, then a megalopolis.
guide.minecities.found.1:
Craft a town hall and place it: you become the mayor.

Rename it in an anvil before placing it to choose the town's name.
guide.minecities.found.2:
Recipe: a gold ingot between two emeralds, a lectern between planks, a chest between planks.

Founded in a village, the town takes in its villagers.
guide.minecities.found.3:
Click the town hall to open its screen: citizens, buildings, registry, council and granary.

The granary is the town's food store.
guide.minecities.house.1:
Build as you like: a closed room (walls, floor, roof), a door and at least one bed.

Each bed houses one citizen.
guide.minecities.house.2:
Hang a house plaque on an inside wall: the house is surveyed.

Green door: registered. Red: a message says what is missing. Click to survey again.
guide.minecities.citizens.1:
Five residents arrive on their own. After that, the town grows through births.

By day they stroll or work; at night they sleep in their beds.
guide.minecities.citizens.2:
They eat from their house's chests, or else from the granary. Starving, they waste away.

Vary their meals: soups, stews and pies make them happy.
guide.minecities.citizens.3:
Happiness from 0 to 10. Happy, they work fast and have children; unhappy for too long, they leave.

Right-click a citizen to see what they lack.
guide.minecities.citizens.4:
Citizens who get along ask to marry: answer in the Registry tab.

Married, fed and with a free bed, they have a child who grows up in three days.
guide.minecities.jobs.1:
A registered building with a vanilla workstation becomes a workshop. Each station employs a citizen.

They often need a tool, from the granary or warehouse.
guide.minecities.jobs.2:
Composter: farmer (hoe)
Smoker: cook
Chopping block (stripped log): lumberjack (axe)
Hay bale: breeder
Barrel by water: fisher (rod)
Furnace: baker
guide.minecities.jobs.3:
Crafting table: builder
Cartography table: courier
Carpenter's bench: carpenter
Stonecutter: mason
Glass kiln: glassblower
Loom: weaver
guide.minecities.jobs.4:
Grindstone: guard (sword)
Fletching table: archer (bow)
Smithing table: inventor
Brewing stand: doctor
Mine winch: miner (pickaxe)
Beehive: beekeeper (shears)
guide.minecities.jobs.5:
Tanning rack: tanner

From town tier:
Lectern: merchant
Blast furnace: smith
Jeweler's bench: jeweler
Chiseled bookshelf: librarian
guide.minecities.build.1:
Take the blueprint at the town hall (Plans tab, Choose): one blueprint serves every building.

Right-click the air: the building and its style. Then use it on the ground, or /ville build <blueprint>.
guide.minecities.build.2:
The building's ghost appears: rotate it (sneaking), then confirm or abandon it, from the blueprint or the chat.

While you hold the blueprint, ongoing sites show in amber.
guide.minecities.build.3:
Builders clear the ground and place blocks taken from the granary and warehouse. The mayor hears what is missing.

Once finished, the building registers itself.
guide.minecities.build.4:
Four levels: hut, house, hall, mansion. Inside a building, /ville upgrade improves it.

Each level adds beds or a station, and work goes faster.
guide.minecities.storage.1:
A warehouse ledger placed in a registered building makes it the warehouse: its chests are the common store.

Food and emeralds go to the granary.
guide.minecities.storage.2: With couriers, workers leave their output in their workshop: couriers store it and bring builders what they ask for.
guide.minecities.growth.1:
Tiers (residents, houses):
Village
Town: 10 and 4
City: 30 and 12
Megalopolis: 75 and 30

Each tier widens the territory and unlocks jobs.
guide.minecities.growth.2: From city tier, place town hall annexes at least 40 blocks from the town hall: they widen the territory and have their own granary.
guide.minecities.health.1:
Out in the rain without a coat, citizens catch a cold or a fever; eating rotten flesh brings dysentery.

The sick work slower, feel low, and infect their neighbours.
guide.minecities.health.2:
The doctor heals with the remedy, taken from the stores:
Cold: honey bottle
Dysentery: milk bucket
Fever: glistering melon (they make it)

The weaver's coat keeps the rain off.
guide.minecities.city.1:
Monuments: statue, fountain, belfry, one of each, in the Plans tab.

They make citizens happier and add appeal: the tavern draws people faster.
guide.minecities.city.2: Disasters: lightning sets a building on fire (water buckets in the granary, citizens put it out); a blight spoils the fields for a day; a quake knocks blocks down.
guide.minecities.city.3:
The Map button shows the territory and its buildings.

In a building, Upgrade orders the next level.

A spent mine shaft is filled in from the winch screen.
guide.minecities.budget.1:
Place a tax box: the tax falls into it every morning (rate in the Council tab).

Guards and archers earn an emerald a day; sites from level 2 cost emeralds.
guide.minecities.budget.2:
Beyond five residents, a tavern and its taverner draw newcomers, if there are beds and happiness.

A level-4 workshop becomes a master's once the librarian lends it a book.
guide.minecities.recipes.1:
Plaque: wooden slab, iron nugget, black dye.
Ledger: book, feather, barrel, in a column.
Winch: logs, string, planks, chain.
Annex: planks, map, barrel, logs.
guide.minecities.recipes.2:
Tax box: iron, emerald, chest, dark oak planks.
Coat: leather and wool.
Stations: a crafting table and the job's item.

The recipe book shows them all.
guide.minecities.defense.1:
From 8 residents, pillagers may attack at dusk. Guards, archers and the inventor's golems defend the town hall.

A victory brings emeralds.
guide.minecities.defense.2:
Ring a bell on the territory: a two-minute alert. Civilians take shelter, guards rush in, monsters glow.

Ring again to end it.
guide.minecities.council.1:
Festival: 4 emeralds from the granary, everyone dances and is happier for a day.

Decrees, from the town tier: rationing, overtime, holiday, curfew, open borders (Council tab).
guide.minecities.council.2:
Trade: /ville trade <town>. Once both mayors sign, caravans swap surpluses for emeralds.

A merchant is needed.

station.minecities.farmer: Harvests ripe crops around the workshop, replants and brings the harvest to the granary. Needs a hoe.
station.minecities.cook: Cooks what the granary has raw, and bakes bread from wheat.
station.minecities.lumberjack: Fells trees around the workshop and replants saplings. Needs an axe.
station.minecities.breeder: Breeds the animals of the nearby pen and culls the surplus, with wheat from the granary.
station.minecities.fisherman: Fishes from the shore: the station must be within 6 blocks of water. Needs a fishing rod.
station.minecities.builder: Builds the sites the mayor orders (plan or /ville build), with materials from the granary. A pickaxe, shovel and axe help clear the ground; scaffolding for roofs.
station.minecities.courier: Brings builders the materials they ask for, and shuttles between workshops, warehouse and granary.
station.minecities.guard: Guards the town day and night and fights whatever attacks it. Needs a sword.
station.minecities.archer: Shoots from the top of a guard tower. Needs a bow, and arrows in the granary.
station.minecities.inventor: Builds golems when the town is attacked, with iron, snow and pumpkins from the granary.
station.minecities.doctor: Heals the injured and the sick (honey, milk, glistering melon) and feeds the starving.
station.minecities.merchant: Sells the granary's surplus and buys what workers lack. From Town tier.
station.minecities.smith: Smelts ores, forges tools and equips the guards. From Town tier.
station.minecities.miner: Digs a gallery under the territory and brings back stone and ores. Needs a pickaxe.
station.minecities.jeweler: Crafts jewellery the merchant sells dear. From Town tier.
station.minecities.mason: Cuts stone, fires bricks, polishes andesite.
station.minecities.glassblower: Melts sand into glass, makes panes, stained glass and bottles.
station.minecities.weaver: Spins wool, sews beds and coats.
station.minecities.beekeeper: Gathers honey and combs from the hives. Needs shears.
station.minecities.librarian: Makes books and teaches the children; the town is happier for it. From Town tier.
station.minecities.taverner: Serves drinks (honey, berries, apples): the town is merrier, and the tavern draws new residents.
station.minecities.tanner: Tans hides into leather and sews tunics.
station.minecities.carpenter: Saws logs and makes doors, fences, stairs… for the builders.

guide.minecities.jobs.6:
Every job also has its mod station: a crafting table and an item of the trade. Right-click: its interface.

On founding, you get the builder's bench.
